stayover_logic: If stay > 5N, apply 3N cycle; if 8N, change after 2N then resume 3N.
If 8N change would fall on Monday, drop that change to Monday and continue cycle so service linen is on Tuesday.
bed_config_notes: King: 1x King top + 2x King plain + 4 pillowcases (or 2).
Twin (T): two single beds → 2x single top + 4x single plain.
Rollaway/Sofa: count on request; choose size mapping at setup.
